models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B
models.why: A 125B MoE at ~21 tok/s decode on a single RTX 4090 24GB by keeping attention on the GPU and streaming expert layers from system RAM with an experimental llama.cpp build (-cmoe), 250K context.

engines.hardware: RTX 4090 24GB + 110GB DDR4 system RAM (hybrid: 40 expert layers on GPU, -cmoe CPU expert offload), Ubuntu 22
engines.quant: Q4_K_XL GGUF ~111.4GB across 4 shards; no MTP, no DFlash2, no KV-cache quant; experimental llama.cpp build with -cmoe

models.name: Bonsai 2 9B
models.why: Bonsai Oryon packages PrismML's llama.cpp fork into one .deb so Ternary Bonsai 2 9B runs CPU-only on Snapdragon X + Debian, 2.2x faster prompt processing than the stock build (34.8 vs 15.6 tok/s).

engines.hardware: Lenovo Snapdragon X laptop, CPU-only, Debian
engines.quant: Prompt processing 34.8 tok/s vs 15.6 stock (2.2x); PrismML llama.cpp fork + ggml, one .deb, no compiling

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B
models.why: A 120B MoE tuned in llama.cpp to a genuinely usable daily driver on one RTX 5090: mmap off plus the GGUF's built-in MTP head reaches 35.1 tok/s at 64K and 30.8 tok/s at 262K with 57 of 88 layer parts' experts on the CPU.

engines.hardware: RTX 5090 24GB + 64GB system RAM (29.6 GiB VRAM, 57 of 88 layer parts' experts on CPU)
engines.quant: Q4_K_M from LM Studio, llama.cpp b11696; --fit on, --load-mode none, --spec-type draft-mtp n 3, -ub 4096; built-in MTP head (acceptance 80-88%); stock --fit is 22.3 tok/s, 30.8 tok/s at 262K

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PlayStation 5 Slim, 16GB unified GDDR6 (448 GB/s), native-app GPU via RADV/Mesa Vulkan on RDNA 2
engines.quant: UD-Q2_K_XL 9.83 GB (9.15 GiB) weight file; PS5LM native GPU app, ~64K context listed by the project
